notes: Figures are my best recall of the real car with no web access, so confidence is medium, not high. Most uncertain: wheelbase 2032 mm, rear track 1270 mm and tyre overall diameter 490 mm (10 inch rims on 145 section tyres); length 3300 mm, width 1400 mm and height 1400 mm are estimates within about 50 mm. track_front is not a real track at all: the car has ONE front wheel in the centre, so there is no front track, and the 145 mm shown is the tyre section width, given only because the checker requires a positive figure. The rear is the important shape: a short near-vertical truncated hatch tail (the back panel drops almost straight down at x -50) with no boot deck, and the roof runs well back until about x -30 before the rear glass falls to the tail. The greenhouse runs from the windscreen base (x 15.5, y 30.4) back to the rear pillar at (x -45, y 32), with its top at y 40.5 just under the roof crown at y 42.4. Proportions that matter most: the huge 42.4 unit height against only 100 units of length, the rounded nose above the single front wheel, the domed roof and the short truncated tail. Bonnet, windscreen rake and tail curve are drawn from a written description of the shape, not from a photo I could check.
